name: hello-aflt-improve
goal: Continue eval-gated improvement rounds on an existing tile-dungeon repo that already has the M5a harness. THIS loop starts at 0 of 3 improve rounds regardless of leftover eval/history.jsonl, latest-score.json, or plateau.json from a prior hello-aflt loop. Stop only for THIS loop's own gate plateau/regression, THIS loop reaching 3 kept improve-* phases, or live overall >= 99 (from node scripts/eval/eval.js --json, not stale plateau/latest-score). Zero-dependency Node ESM; default PORT 8792.
acceptance: At most 3 improve rounds applied in THIS loop (count passed improve-* phases in loop state, not history.jsonl lines). Each round uses portable improve-gate.js (definition-dir resolved) that compares overall from committed HEAD vs the uncommitted working tree (never history.jsonl, never before/after itself on the dirty tree). Suite stays green. Locked scripts/eval/eval.js and scripts/eval/scorer.js untouched. Local commits per passed improve phase allowed; no remotes, no push. Improve sessions use unique titles per loop+round (e.g. hello-aflt-improve-r1).
